_note: Trimmed to 3 of the 6 Michigan-located NWR features found in the bbox query for size (dropped Detroit River IWR, Michigan Islands NWR, Seney NWR here). This layer has no STATE field; Michigan refuges must be selected by LIT code allowlist or spatial join against a MI boundary, not by attribute filter alone. RSL_TYPE also includes non-refuge FWS land categories (WPA, FSA, NFH, COORD, AS) that should be excluded.
